snippet.title: NEROBI biggest update is out now!
snippet.description:
In an ancient land, within mysterious forests and across desolate wastelands… after an entire year of work, Nerobi finally releases a massive update!

The adventure expands—there’s no more room for hesitation. Now it’s up to you to shape your own destiny!
Check out our newest update on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2534250/Nerobi/

#gamedev #indiegame #gamedeveloper #nerobi
